## Positioning by target role

### Engineering Manager

Emphasize: people leadership, technical leadership, architecture, product partnership, delivery, reliability, organizational design, coaching and succession.

### Senior Engineering Manager / Director

Emphasize: multi-team leadership, organizational design, strategy, executive communication, platform ownership, business impact, transformation.

### Tech Lead / Principal / Senior Backend

Emphasize: Java, Spring, APIs, distributed systems, cloud, event-driven architecture, scalability, reliability, modernization.

### AI Engineering / AI-enabled leadership

Emphasize: AI agents, AI-assisted development, workflow automation, context engineering, human validation, AI applied to real engineering and management problems.
